_comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/habits.json and edit. All patterns are case-insensitive regexes searched in paths (forward slashes), commands, URLs or queries. docs: files or folders, relative to the project or absolute; a reminder fires at session end if a trigger happened and none of its docs changed afterwards. once_per_session (optional): remind at most once per session, for rules that would otherwise fire every turn. tokens (optional, these are the defaults): context warning past context_warn then every context_step tokens; big_output = tool output size (tokens) that gets a nudge.

block.message: Don't force-push: use --force-with-lease, or ask the user first.

reminders.name: changelog
reminders.message: This session changed user-facing code (src/ edit or a deploy) but CHANGELOG.md has no newer edit. Add a line under Unreleased, or say why this change doesn't need one.

reminders.name: knowledge
reminders.message: This session did research (probes, reference reads, docs lookups) but docs/knowledge/ has no newer edit. Record what was learned (Status + Evidence; tested / researched / guess), or say why nothing new was learned.
